newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down against dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down against dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2899 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday in the face of technical selling after it hit a 26-month high close of 8.2895 on Tuesday, traders said.
Dealers said sentiment towards the currency remained bullish.
"The fall today was purely due to a technical correction," said a dealer.
Dealers said the yuan faced selling pressure at around the 8.2900 level after its show of strength on Tuesday.
Trading was less active than Tuesday with most business done at 8.2900. The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2903.
"Judging from the fact that the yuan closed above the key 8.2900 level again on Wedensday, the local currency apparently still has strong support," said a dealer.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around the 8.2900 level on Thursday.
The yuan opened down at 8.2902 and fell to an intraday low of 8.2912 in early trading. It then rose steadily to move around 8.2900 for most of the trading, hitting a high of 8.2850.
The yuan closed up at 6.9430 from 7.0001 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0702 from 1.0699 against the Hong Kong dollar.
